label: No Vent

profile.distinguishingDetail: A ventless back presents an unbroken, clean horizontal line across the entire hem of the jacket — no slits, no flaps, nothing to interrupt the silhouette from behind. Most closely associated with Italian tailoring and tuxedos globally, it creates a sleek, close-fitting appearance that flatters a slim physique and reads as fashion-forward and elegant when standing. The trade-off is mobility: sitting or reaching forward causes the back to pull and bunch, making it the least practical option for anyone who spends significant time seated.
